item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇩 Embassy of Russia in Indonesia : On August 31 2026, at the personal initiative of staff members of Russian diplomatic missions and representative offices in Jakarta and in response to a request from residents of Nagekeo, East Nusa Tenggara Province, humanitarian assistance for communities impacted by the earthquake on Flores Island was delivered to Indonesia’s National Agency for Disaster Management . The assistance included rice, cooking oil, instant noodles, and other essential food and household supplies intended to support local families in need . 🤝 The initiative reflects genuine solidarity with those affected by the earthquake and aims to support local communities during this difficult time. #RussiaIndonesia #RussiaHelps

, as well as by

, during
our meeting in Moscow
, conveyed your message, and I fully share everything set out in it.
Next year, we will mark
the 80th anniversary of
the establishment of diplomatic relations
, and, of course, we are seriously preparing for
the upcoming #BRICS Summit in New Delhi
in September.

Trade and economic cooperation is showing positive trends overall
. There was a slight decline last year, but in the first half of 2026,
trade turnover increased by 2.6%.
A week ago,
the Intergovernmental Commission met in Moscow
and also reported good results.
I would also like to say a few words about
humanitarian cooperation
. India is among the leaders in terms of the number of students studying in Russia:
over the past 10 years, their number has increased sevenfold and now stands at almost 40,000
.
Cultural festivals
are held regularly – both Indian culture festivals and Russian culture festivals. The next one is scheduled to take place

.
Tourist exchanges
are also developing rapidly
, increasing by 16% in 2025.

We closely coordinate our efforts
within the
#UN
,
#BRICS
,
#G20
and, of course, the
#SCO
. Today, we have a very good opportunity to compare notes and chart the way forward in developing Russia-India relations.

🇷🇺

Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during
the meeting
with President of China Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the SCO Summit
(Bishkek, August 31, 2026)
.
💬
President Putin:
I am sincerely glad
to meet with you again
– this time in Kyrgyzstan.
I would like to begin with
the tragic events
that recently occurred in China’s Tibet Autonomous Region, near the border with Nepal – a powerful mudslide struck the area, resulting in loss of life.
▪️
Please convey
our deepest condolences
to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives, as well as
our wishes for a speedy recovery
to all those injured.
***
We are meeting just a few hours before the start of
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
.
☝️
The SCO was established 25 years ago at the initiative of China and Russia.
I am very pleased to note that our initiative has developed so successfully, acquired a truly broad international character and grown into a full-fledged international organisation.
This year we also marked
the 25th anniversary of the fundamental
Treaty of Good-Neighbourliness and Friendly Cooperation
, signed by Comrade
Jiang Zemin
, who would have turned 100 on August 17. We remember his contribution to the development of Russia-China relations.
Today, amid a complex geopolitical environment,
the comprehensive partnership and strategic interaction between Russia and China
serve as a model of interstate relations.
🤝
They are founded on strong traditions of friendship, respect for sovereignty, equality and mutual benefit.
Cooperation is developing successfully across all areas, including the economy
. We are implementing major projects in energy, industry, space, transport and logistics. The first regular voyage by a Chinese container ship along
the Northern Sea Route
took place in mid-August.
Mutual agricultural trade
is growing rapidly – up 34%
.
Digital innovation
, including artificial intelligence technologies,
is opening up new opportunities
for the economic development of our countries
. Together with our Chinese friends, we established
the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization
in 2026. This was your initiative, which we were pleased to support, and we are committed to working together in this field.
Business and humanitarian contacts are undoubtedly facilitated by
the 30-day visa-free regime
. You announced this initiative a year ago, on September 2, during
our meeting in Beijing
.
We supported it, and the arrangement is now in effect through the end of 2027.
The results were immediate:
tourist flows increased by 43% in the first half of 2026
. We are ready to work together on
making the visa-free regime permanent
, should the Chinese Side consider this possible and beneficial.
🌐
As for current foreign policy issues,
our fundamental approaches are close or fully aligned
. In addition to the
#SCO
, we actively cooperate within the
#UN
,
#BRICS
,
#G20
and ASEAN-centred formats, and, of course, we will continue supporting
China’s chairmanship of #APEC.
#RussiaChina

item.description: 🇲🇾 On August 31, #Malaysia marks Independence Day. #OTD in 1957, this nation gained freedom from British colonial rule, which heralded a new chapter in the development of the Malaysian statehood. The country’s history traces back to the XIV century with the establishment of Malacca Sultanate. Two centuries later, European colonisers began taking the Malay Peninsula under control: first the Portuguese , then followed by the Dutch . By the late 1760s, the Brits came to the region — a direct implication of the British East India Company’s expansion into Southeast Asia. The English colonisers built their first fortifications on Penang Island and leased land along the peninsula’s coast. In 1815, following the Napoleonic Wars in Europe, Malaya (along with Singapore) was ceded to Britain. London ruthlessly exploited the local population and resources of the controlled territory. The colonisers crushed any opposition to the Crown and fueled ethnic discord. During #WW2 , Malaysia was occupied by the Japanese forces. 🇲🇾
On August 31,
#Malaysia
marks Independence Day.
#OTD
in 1957, this
nation gained freedom from British colonial rule,
which heralded a new chapter in the development of the Malaysian statehood.
The country’s history traces back to the XIV century with the establishment of Malacca Sultanate. Two centuries later,
European colonisers
began taking the Malay Peninsula under control: first the
Portuguese
, then followed by the
Dutch
.
By the late 1760s, the Brits came to the region — a direct implication of the British East India Company’s
expansion
into Southeast Asia. The
English colonisers
built their first fortifications on Penang Island and leased land along the peninsula’s coast. In 1815, following the Napoleonic Wars in Europe, Malaya (along with Singapore) was ceded to Britain.
London
ruthlessly
exploited
the local population and resources of the controlled territory. The colonisers
crushed any opposition
to the Crown and fueled ethnic discord.
During
#WW2
, Malaysia
was occupied by the Japanese
forces. The British, who had spent decades relentlessly extracting the region’s natural resources, proved incapable of defending the country —
British troops even abandoned Malaya
altogether. Following their retreat, the
Japanese invaders imposed a brutal occupation regime:
estimates suggest that of Malaya’s 4.4 million of local population, approximately 700'000 (over 15% of the population) perished due to atrocities by Japanese war criminals.
Throughout Japan’s occupation of Malaya,
👉
London failed to provide its people with any meaningful help or assistance in fighting the enemy.
Left to face the Japanese alone, the Malaysian people rose in resistance: guerrilla units fought courageously and selflessly against the invaders until militarist Japan's surrender in 1945.
After Japan’s defeat, Britain did not contribute to the post-war rebuilding in Malaya, even though
the region had suffered far greater human casualties
than Britain did itself. Instead, London reinstated a ruthless exploitative regime. Among Malaysians, who had, in fact, liberated their Motherland single-handedly, anti-colonial sentiment grew there, culminating in a
mass national liberation movement
for independence.
In 1957,
Malaysians finally cast off the shackles of British colonial rule
. In the same year, the Declaration of Independence of Malaysia was adopted.
***
🇷🇺
🇲🇾
#RussiaMalaysia
Diplomatic relations between our countries were
established
on April 3, 1967. Six months later, a Soviet trade mission opened in Kuala Lumpur.
🤝
Malaysia is Russia’s long-standing and reliable partner in the Asia-Pacific region
.
Today, Russian-Malaysian
ties are
friendly and actively developing
across multiple areas. Our interaction has invariably been built on the principles of
mutual respect
and
consideration for each other’s interests
. Moscow and Kuala Lumpur also coordinate their efforts in international formats, including the
#UN
,
#BRICS
,
#ASEAN
, and the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (
#OIC
).
📈
Trade and economic cooperation is developing dynamically. Last year,
trade turnover
between our countries
increased by 12.9%.
💬
Russian President
Vladimir
Putin
at the
meeting
with Malaysian Prime Minister
Anwar
Ibrahim
ahead of the
#RussiaASEAN
Summit
(June 17, 2026):
In 2027, we will mark the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations.
We approach this date with extensive positive experience of mutually beneficial cooperation and a strong foundation for its further expansion.
🎉
We extend cordial greetings to our Malaysian colleagues on their national holiday, wish them well-being and prosperity!

item.title: 🗓 #Announcement On September 1-4, Vladivostok will host the 11th Eastern Economic Forum
item.description: #Announcement 🗓 On September 1-4, Vladivostok will host the 11th Eastern Economic Forum ( #EEF ). August 31 marks the

independent, sovereign and democratic state.
Diplomatic relations between the Russian Federation and the Kyrgyz Republic were established on March 20, 1992.
🌐
The relations between our countries are expanding dynamically in the spirit of
strategic partnership and alliance.
Moscow and Bishkek are cooperating fruitfully across a wide range of areas and are closely involved within the
#CSTO
, the
#EurasianEconomicUnion
, the
#CIS
, the
#SCO
, and other multilateral platforms.
Russia and Kyrgyzstan maintain regular top- and high-level contacts and
actively develop bilateral inter-departmental ties.
Our countries are implementing joint projects in energy, industry, transport as well as cultural and humanitarian spheres.
💬
President of the Russian Federation
Vladimir
Putin
in the Independence Day
greetings
to President of Kyrgyzstan
Sadyr
Japarov
on the republic’s Independence Day
(August 31, 2026):
✍️
Under your leadership, Kyrgyzstan is successfully addressing the social and economic challenges it faces and is steadily strengthening its international standing.
We will, of course, continue to work closely together on the bilateral, regional, and international agendas.
I am confident that our forthcoming meeting in Bishkek will further enhance mutually beneficial Russian‑Kyrgyz cooperation and contribute to strengthening security and stability in the Eurasian region.
🎉
We congratulate our Kyrgyz colleagues and the people of Kyrgyzstan on their national holiday
—
3️⃣
5️⃣
th Anniversary of the proclamation of independence of the Kyrgyz Republic
!
